---
title: Spatial UI
---

Build a movable, resizable interface with the core `UICard`, layout, text,
image, button, and slider components. The controls update the card immediately
on desktop and in XR.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Move UI:** Left-click and drag the border/edge of the UI card.
- **Scale UI:** Hover over the UI card and scroll with the mouse wheel.
- **Interact:** Left-click buttons or drag sliders to adjust values.

### XR Controls

- **Move UI:** Pinch the border/edge of the card and drag.
- **Scale UI:** Pinch the card with two hands and stretch or pinch closer to resize.
- **Interact:** Ray-pinch buttons and drag sliders.
